verdict.rationale: Temporal's own docs list first-party Google ADK (Python) and Vercel AI SDK (TypeScript) integrations, and its AI solutions page claims orchestration of AI apps and agents "across any models, tools." That indicates LLM/agent steps can run inside workflows, but the evidence is only integration headings plus marketing copy, and Temporal remains code-first. Missing for 10: documented detail of how LLM/agent steps are added within a workflow, explicit model-selection configuration, documented tool-use/tool-calling mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Orchestrate your workflows, AI apps, and agents across any models, tools, systems, and length of time.
